issues.description: The problem statement and the template declare getAverageRating() to return a Double, but the solution implementation returns a Float. The problem hint explicitly shows converting sums to Double, and the template signature is -> Double, while the solution's signature is -> Float and performs Float arithmetic. This mismatch between artifacts is structural (method return type) and can confuse students about the expected return type and cause type-related test or compilation issues.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the solution consistent with the problem statement and template by changing getAverageRating() in the solution to return Double (-> Double) and perform the average calculation using Double casting (e.g. Double(starSum) / Double(totalRatings)). Alternatively, if Float was intended, update the problem statement and template signatures/hints to specify Float instead of Double. Prefer aligning to Double to match the explicit problem hint and template.
